messages:
Rita: quick summary — ran orion-lite (768d) fp16 vs int8-perchannel on shortseq holdout. posting raw recall + clustering stats below.
Sam: nice, paste the numbers pls. short messages are where we often see regressions.
Rita: table (shortseq-qa): fp16 recall@1 0.61, @5 0.74, @10 0.82; int8-perchannel recall@1 0.59, @5 0.71, @10 0.78; int8-pertensor recall@1 0.56, @5 0.69, @10 0.75.
Jordan: thanks. embedding pipeline - L2 normalize then cosine? or raw dot?
Rita: L2 normalize -> cosine. dim 768. quant done post-embedding projection (weight-only quant). no KV cache changes.
Ava: any stratification by query length? short queries often lose more signal.
Rita: good call — stratified results: <=32 tokens: fp16 @10 0.79 -> int8 0.72 (delta -0.07). 33-128 tokens: fp16 0.84 -> int8 0.82 (delta -0.02). So shorttail is hit hardest.
Sam: that’s larger than expected for small queries. what about clustering metrics? silhouette / ARI?
Rita: kmeans k=200 on holdout: fp16 silhouette avg 0.42, int8-perchannel 0.39, int8-pertensor 0.35. ARI (labels from our coarse taxonomy): fp16 0.48 -> int8-perchannel 0.44.
Jordan: visually any tail collapse in UMAP?
Rita: yes — attaching link to quick UMAP: https://internal.redwood/imgs/orionlite-shortseq-umap.png (red = fp16, blue = int8-perchannel). small clusters smear into larger ones for int8 on short queries.
Ava: could this be calibration related? try per-channel vs per-tensor scales and symmetric quantization? also check clamp thresholds.
Rita: tried symmetric per-channel w/ clamp 127 -> improved perchannel recall@10 to 0.80 (from 0.78) but still below fp16. per-tensor symmetric still behind.
Sam: next steps proposal: 1) run per-sample minmax calibration on a short-query subset, 2) test asymmetric quantization, 3) run ensemble (avg of fp16+int8) for canary fallback.
Rita: will queue those. I'll also run microbatching/noise test — continuous batching could change numeric rounding w/ accumulator.
ml-eval-bot: job queued: eval-2417 (orion-lite shortseq stratified; calibs: perchannel-symm, pertensor-asymm, per-sample-minmax). ETA ~3h.
Sam: once ml-eval-bot finishes, if short-query delta > 0.03 we should gate canary and add auto-fallback to fp16 for queries <64 tokens. :thumbsup:
Rita: noted. opening ticket INF-8923 (orion-lite int8 shortseq regression). will report back with full logs and per-layer norms.
Jordan: tiny nit — include 95th percentile distance shift per layer (proj + norm) in the next dump. that helps pinpoint which matmuls are noisy.
Rita: will do. thanks everyone.
